column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Raphael and Rupirupi's Awakening
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: What fools!!
It is because they believe in such deceptions as $$愛$$ and $$正義$$
that they fell so easily into a trap like that.
By now they must have evaporated, leaving only their armor behind!!
All that remains is to recover the remaining armor of the $$大邪神$$...
$$封印$$ it away once more, and restore the chain that binds this $$世界$$...
Then this $$この世$$ will again become a $$世界$$ filled with the $$七つの美徳$$, free of hypocrisy and pretty lies!!
Oh? Are you sure about that?
Y-you people!!
Sorry, but your so-called virtues make me sick!!
Unforgivable! I will not forgive you!!
Your countless arrogant, cold deeds, carried out in your god's name, trampling the rights of the $$弱者$$!
Even if you are $$大天使$$...
no one has the right to decide another person's right to live...
on their own whim...
Much less the right to persecute people for their age or station...
for the color of their $$羽$$ or their sex...
You cannot possibly possess such a right!
I'm sorry, $$お師匠さま$$.
Enough. That is enough, $$ルピルピ$$!
Tell me, $$お師匠さま$$, did you know?
I $$愛$$d you, $$お師匠さま$$.
I... I knew.
But I am such an old man...
And more than anything, this body could never make you happy.
That doesn't matter!
But I'm glad... you really understood!
I love you too...
Please don't be sad.
From now on, we will always, always be together...
Always... together...
T-those six $$羽$$!?
N-now... I understand everything...
Why Lord $$メフィスト$$ chose not me...
but you, some nobody, to make ruler of that city...
Your true identity is...
the one who pitied the $$サル$$ whom the $$大悪神・ゴッド$$ meant to exterminate...
and refused to join the $$創世記戦争$$ in order to save them...
the $$大邪神$$ $$ラファエル$$, with six $$羽$$!!
And yet... after that war, you submitted to Lord $$サタン$$,
and were supposed to have contributed to this $$世界$$'s new rebirth...
Yet now you mean to betray even us...
Is that what you are saying!?
When I betrayed $$ゴッド$$ then...
it was because, for the paltry reason that they had “learned speech and the use of fire,”
he meant to exterminate every $$サル達$$ he had created...
I could not abide $$ゴッド$$'s way of doing things!!
But even the lives they have gained by siding with you...
have now become utterly intolerable!
Perhaps $$メフィスト$$ made me a $$大神官$$ from the beginning, knowing this would happen...
and entrusted me with the armor that holds his own soul...
I-impossible...!!
Without even your own armor of the $$大邪神$$...
you think you can defeat us...?
Do you!?
The armor is right here!
To begin with, the true purpose of the armor you wear is...
to guard against your own death in sudden battle...
by allowing a copy of one's own soul to be stored as a $$記憶$$ within the armor beforehand!!
In other words, the armor's strength
is directly proportional to the strength of its original owner.
That is why...
if the person wearing that armor
is not accepted by the soul of the armor's true owner...
the armor runs wild and devours its wearer from within...!
Put another way, the armor angels wear...
has no inherent ranking at all.
Unlike $$大天使$$ like you, who have been reincarnated again and again,
I have not been reincarnated once since before that war...
even this $$邪道騎士$$ armor containing $$ルピルピ$$'s soul...
can become true armor of the $$大邪神$$ when I wear it!!
Now I can say it plainly.
$$ルピルピ$$, I $$愛$$ you!
Come on!! Let us resume this so-called $$創世記戦争$$ and settle it!!
